finding: The BE98 PSI backport deliberately omitted pagecache-thrashing accounting to avoid renumbering page flags baked into Broadcom blobs. The users recollection is confirmed by the original commit, including its Claude co-author trailer.

original_commit.title: sched/psi: backport pressure stall information from 4.20
original_commit.author: leonpano2006

historical_constraints.upstream_risk: Inserting the 4-byte field in the upstream location shifts pre-existing task fields
historical_constraints.historical_solution: Use padding at offset1908, after pagefault_disabled1904 and before oom_reaper_list1912
Use spare bit in existing32-bit word at offset932; old bits retained

historical_constraints.deliberate_omission: Drop filemap PSI hunks because adding PG_workingset in the middle of enum pageflags renumbers old flags used as immediate constants in prebuilt Broadcom code
historical_constraints.consequence: Reclaim, compaction and swap stalls counted; pagecache-thrash stalls not counted

historical_constraints.related_documented_constraint: The separate zswap meminfo backport dropped its vmstat half because growing vm_event_item resizes a per-CPU array; avoid casually extending enums while filling PSI coverage.

local_evidence.local_upstream_clone: /home/leonpano/amng-build is a shallow upstream checkout, not the BE98 modification history
local_evidence.verification_method: Read original published GitHub commit through read-only public API after locating matching local archived README; confirmed exact task patch and absence of mm/filemap.c in the18-file change.

solved: Original task layout remains2688 bytes; psi_flags1908 unchanged; newin_memstall uses existing word936 bit5
Cgroup PSI state lives after dynamic ancestor_ids allocation instead of expanding856-byte cgroup
Poll dispatch preserves cftype208 and kernfs_ops88; avoids API-structure growth
comparison_with_kernel7.not_solved_by_tail_allocation: Cgroup tail allocation does not implement PG_workingset marking/refault semantics or filemap waiting/bio I/O PSI charging. Those were the original intentionally omitted MM features.
comparison_with_kernel7.attribution_limit: Only filemap/PG_workingset omission is explicitly attributed to the blob rule in this commit. Do not claim every missing cgroup/poll/modern PSI feature was deliberately deleted by Claude; later upstream PSI features did not yet exist in the selected4.20 implementation.

concrete_followup_for_kernel8: Append PG_workingset at the end of existing pageflags with every old enum value unchanged; independently prove free low bit and no collision with zone/node/section/last_cpupid high-bit packing.
Carry working-set state through refault/eviction/activation and page migration before enabling filemap wait accounting, so repeated thrashing is identified rather than charging every file read.
Introduce BIO_WORKINGSET only in an available existing bio flag bit; preserve BVEC_POOL_OFFSET, all existing bio flags, and sizeof/offsets of struct bio.
Do not add WORKINGSET_RESTORE or resize the vm-event/node-stat arrays solely for this PSI backport; capture baseline enums/counts in compile-only ABI probe.
Verify exact final kernel page/bio layouts, enum encodings, PSI refault and bounded file-I/O notifications in QEMU, then rerun stock modules before any hardware trial.
